description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeImmigrationController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling employee immigration data within the PIM plugin. It includes methods to prepare the view component with employee-specific data such as country list and permissions, using services via dependency injection.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationController
classes.description: Controller for managing employee immigration information, extending base employee view functionality and utilizing Vue components for the frontend interface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the immigration component with employee data and permissions before rendering the view.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data capability groups required for authorization checks related to immigration.
